Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses two types of affinity pull-downs: RNA-assisted pull-down (using MS2-MBP) and direct RBPMS pull-down (using StrepII-His6 tags). Both were analyzed via label-free DDA LC-MS/MS. No PTM enrichments were performed.

scope: Liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (LC–MS/MS) was used to identify and quantify proteins recovered from RNA assisted pull-down.
For an affinity purification–mass spectrometry (AP–MS) experiment, sample preparation, peptide identification and raw data processing were identical to those described above.
The model RNA is tethered on amylose bead via a protein, MPB-MS2. After pull-down, the protein-RNA complexes are eluted from the beads with maltose.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiments involved two types of affinity purification: RNA-assisted pull-down (using MS2-MBP and amylose beads) and AP-MS of the RBPMS proteome (using MagStrep beads). While HeLa nuclear extract (NE) was used as the source material for the complexes, the material actually analyzed by MS was the purified eluate from these affinity captures.
